SEARCH
Package Model

Class Course

java.lang.Object
Model.Entity
Model.Course
All Implemented Interfaces:
android.os.Parcelable
public class Course extends Entity implements android.os.Parcelable
Represents a course offering, including its schedule, participants, capacity, and related metadata. Extends Entity to inherit a unique ID and implements Parcelable for Android IPC.

      public Course(String id, CourseType type, String name, ArrayList<Client> participants, int capacity, AgeRange ageRange, Schedule schedule, Category category, String description, String businessId, int duration)
      Full constructor.
      Parameters:
      id - unique course ID
      type - format of the course (solo/duo/group)
      name - display name of the course
      participants - list of enrolled clients
      capacity - maximum number of participants
      ageRange - allowed age range for participants
      schedule - timing details of the course
      category - activity category (e.g. Yoga, Football)
      description - descriptive summary
      businessId - ID of the business offering this course
      duration - duration in minutes
